title: Darts Equipment & Precision Engineering: Tungsten Barrels, Flights & Shaft Aerodynamics
description: Advanced equipment English module examining high-density tungsten metallurgy, flight surface aerodynamics, and custom barrel grip engineering.
learning_objectives: Master advanced technical jargon in sports engineering (95% tungsten density, knurling, shark fin grips, flight aerodynamics)
Apply inverted conditionals and negative inversion in technical equipment evaluation
Demonstrate high-register precision when drafting equipment specifications and tolerances

questions.prompt: _____ the manufacturer not utilized 95% high-density tungsten billets, the dart barrel would have been too bulky for tight grouping.

explanations.correct: Inverted Third Conditional 'Had the manufacturer not utilized...' correctly replaces 'If the manufacturer had not utilized...'.
explanations.wrong_A: 'If' requires the auxiliary 'had' after the subject.
explanations.wrong_C: 'Were' forms a Second Conditional, incompatible with past 'would have been'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Inverze 3. kondicionálu: 'Had the manufacturer not utilized...' = 'Kdyby výrobce nepoužil...'. V podmínce se nepoužívá 'if'.

questions.prompt: Under no circumstances _____ match players use bent points that cause severe micro-tears in the sisal dartboard fibers.

explanations.correct: Negative introductory phrase 'Under no circumstances' triggers subject-auxiliary inversion: 'should professional [players use]'.
explanations.wrong_A: 'players should' lacks the required subject-auxiliary inversion.
explanations.wrong_B: 'must to' is ungrammatical; modal 'must' does not take 'to'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Záporná úvodní fráze 'Under no circumstances' vyžaduje převrácený slovosled (inverzi): 'Under no circumstances should players use...'.

questions.prompt: If the champion had tested his barrel grip profile thoroughly during pre-season practice, his release _____ on the oche today.

explanations.correct: Mixed conditional: past unreal action ('had tested') with ongoing present consequence ('today') takes 'would not be slipping'.
explanations.wrong_B: 'would not have slipped' refers purely to past result, but adverbial 'today' anchors consequence to the present.
explanations.wrong_C: 'will not slip' is First Conditional, incompatible with past condition.
explanations.wrong_D: Indicative 'does not slip' cannot express hypothetical consequence.

questions.cz_learning_point: Smíšený kondicionál (Mixed Conditional): minulá příčina spojená s přítomným následkem: 'If he had tested [minulost], it would not be slipping [dnes]'.

questions.prompt: PDC tournament guidelines mandate that each competitor _____ their match darts for weight verification prior to the quarter-finals.

explanations.correct: Mandative subjunctive after 'mandate that' requires the base form 'submit' regardless of singular/plural subject.
explanations.wrong_A: Indicative 'submits' with 3rd person -s violates mandative subjunctive syntax.
explanations.wrong_B: Future 'will submit' is incorrect after mandative 'mandate that'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Subjunktiv po slovesech nařízení (mandate that): sloveso má základní tvar bez koncovky -s: 'mandate that each competitor submit'.

questions.prompt: _____ from standard flights to slim aerodynamic shapes, the player recorded significantly higher drag velocity into the board.

explanations.correct: Perfect active participle 'Having switched' correctly expresses an action completed prior to the main clause action 'recorded'.
explanations.wrong_A: Base verb 'Switch' cannot function as an introductory participle.
explanations.wrong_B: Past form 'Switched' without auxiliary is passive, but the player actively performed the switch.

questions.cz_learning_point: Předpřítomné participium (Having switched = poté, co přešel na...) vyjadřuje děj, který předcházel ději v hlavní větě.

questions.prompt: _____ carbon-composite shafts offer supreme structural rigidity, nylon stems provide greater bounce-out deflection resilience.

explanations.correct: 'Although' is a conjunction followed by a full clause with subject and verb ('carbon-composite shafts offer...').
explanations.wrong_A: 'In spite of' is a preposition and must be followed by a noun phrase or gerund.
explanations.wrong_C: 'Notwithstanding' is followed by a noun phrase.
explanations.wrong_D: 'Despite' is a preposition and cannot be followed directly by a finite clause.

questions.cz_learning_point: Spojka 'Although' (ačkoli) se pojí s celou větou s podmětem a slovesem, zatímco předložky jako 'Despite' a 'In spite of' vyžadují podstatné jméno.

questions.prompt: High-density sintered tungsten is universally acknowledged _____ the precision tolerances of modern competition darts.

explanations.correct: Perfect active infinitive 'to have revolutionized' correctly attributes a past completed breakthrough to tungsten metallurgy.
explanations.wrong_B: Participle 'revolutionizing' cannot follow passive reporting verb 'is acknowledged'.
explanations.wrong_C: Present infinitive 'to revolutionize' fails to convey past completion.
explanations.wrong_D: Passive 'to have been revolutionized' incorrectly treats tungsten as the object rather than the agent.

questions.cz_learning_point: Vazba 'is acknowledged to have revolutionized' (uznává se, že způsobil revoluci) vyjadřuje minulý děj pomocí minulého infinitivu.

questions.prompt: Only after experimenting with multiple shaft lengths _____ the ideal trajectory balance for his throwing rhythm.

explanations.correct: Limiting introductory phrase 'Only after...' triggers subject-auxiliary inversion with Past Simple: 'did the player discover'.
explanations.wrong_B: 'the player discovered' lacks required subject-auxiliary inversion.
explanations.wrong_C: 'discovered the player' is archaic full inversion without auxiliary 'did'.
explanations.wrong_D: Present perfect conflicts with completed past experimentation.

questions.cz_learning_point: Zdůrazňující úvodní vazba 'Only after...' vyžaduje inverzní slovosled: 'Only after experimenting did the player discover...'.

questions.prompt: A professional player averaging over 105 points across five sets _____ with damaged or unbalanced equipment.

explanations.correct: 'Cannot possibly be playing' expresses absolute deductive impossibility based on world-class performance metrics.
explanations.wrong_A: 'must not' expresses prohibition or deduction of absence, but lacks impossibility nuance.
explanations.wrong_B: 'should not' expresses moral obligation or advice.

questions.cz_learning_point: Vyjádření naprosté nemožnosti: 'cannot possibly be playing' (v žádném případě nemůže hrát s poškozeným vybavením).

questions.prompt: Target Darts engineered the patented Swiss Point system, by means of _____ broken points are replaced in seconds using a pocket tool.

explanations.correct: Formal prepositional relative phrase 'by means of which' strictly takes 'which' when modifying a mechanical system.
explanations.wrong_A: 'that' cannot follow a preposition in formal relative clauses.

questions.cz_learning_point: Po předložkových vazbách v rozvitých vztažných větách se pro technické systémy používá výhradně 'which': 'by means of which' (pomocí něhož).
